meta.title: Solutions
meta.description: Nine solutions in five areas: Sovereign AI, Cybersecurity, IoT & Edge, Intelligent Operations and Blockchain. ADP-delivered, partner-enabled, hosted in-Kingdom.

solutionsHub.sub: Five solution areas, each solution with a live demo, a fixed-scope first step (assessment or pilot), project delivery and a managed-service path. One trust layer runs across the portfolio: the same ledger anchors AI decisions, compliance audit trails, IoT readings and work orders from every solution.

solutionPage.whatItDoesSub: Designed, delivered and operated by ADP, with specialist platforms behind every pillar.
